advisories.summary: event-stream 3.3.6 pulled in flatmap-stream 0.1.1, which carried a payload stealing cryptocurrency wallets.
advisories.remediation: Pin event-stream to 3.3.5 or 4.0.1 and remove flatmap-stream.

advisories.summary: Hijacked ua-parser-js releases installed a cryptominer and a password stealer.
advisories.remediation: Use 0.7.30, 0.8.1 or 1.0.1 or later and rotate credentials of machines that installed it.
Use 1.95.8 or later and rotate any key the package could read.

advisories.summary: ultralytics releases published through a compromised build pipeline and token installed a cryptominer.
advisories.remediation: Move to a release not listed here and rebuild the environment.
